fields.description: Talabat's item cart-processing status (NOT_PROCESSED/IN_CART/NOT_FOUND/REPLACED/ADDITION) or, for Noon (#145), the FBPI item's mp_status commercial state (CONFIRMED/CANCELLED - Noon's own MP_ITEM_STATUS_* enum with its verbose prefix stripped - or the documented MP_ITEM_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED value, stored verbatim/unstripped since order_mapper.py's MP_STATUS_MAP deliberately passes unrecognized values through unchanged rather than dropping them). Not a per-platform field: this is the same closed vocabulary every platform's order-commercial-state maps onto.
fields.label: External Item Status
fields.options:
NOT_PROCESSED
IN_CART
NOT_FOUND
REPLACED
ADDITION
CONFIRMED
CANCELLED
MP_ITEM_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED

fields.description: Noon FBPI's fulfillment-progress state (ACKNOWLEDGED/OUT_OF_STOCK/SHIPPED - Noon's own INTEGRATION_ITEM_STATUS_* enum with its verbose prefix stripped - or the documented INTEGRATION_ITEM_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED value, stored verbatim/unstripped for the same reason as external_status above), distinct from external_status's order-commercial-state. Blank for every other platform (#145).
fields.label: Integration Status

fields.description: Set when Talabat's item.pricing.total_price was absent/null in the raw payload. A Float column cannot itself store NULL (it silently coerces to 0.0), so this flag is what actually distinguishes a genuinely missing fulfilled total from a real zero-value line - never derive that distinction from fulfilled_total_price alone.
fields.label: Fulfilled Total Price Missing

fields.description: Set when Shopify's priceAfterAllDiscountsBeforeTaxesSet.shopMoney.amount was absent or null before the Float field's database coercion.
fields.label: Transaction Amount Missing

fields.description: Full Talabat item.promotion array (name, type, discount_amount, sponsorships[]), preserved without interpretation.
fields.label: Promotions
